en.title: Horizontal Pod Autoscaler
en.description: Maintain the pod counts of n microservices. Operation 1 sets the count of a given service directly to x (which may increase or decrease it); operation 2 raises the count of every service below x to x. Execute all operations in order and output the final array.
en.input: The first line contains n, m; the second line contains n initial pods; then m lines follow, each containing typ p x. typ=1 sets 1-based service p directly to x; when typ=2, p must be -1, and max(pods[i],x) is applied to all pods. The original MDX provides no ranges; this site adds 1≤n,m≤200000, 1≤pods[i]≤10^9, 0≤x≤10^9, and defines this stdin/stdout protocol.
en.output: Output the n final pod counts, separated by spaces.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the full approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
hints: A point assignment can lower a single value; do not treat the historical HPA maximum as a lower bound that stays valid forever.
